target: dopecon-bridge promotable stream relay: a background consumer that mirrors promotable event types from dopemux:events -> activity.events.v1, as a publisher-agnostic backstop complementing the ConPort direct-emit fix (auth-blocker finding option 2).
invariants: Every event stream must have >=1 publisher and >=1 consumer.
Fail-closed on protection/identity; fail-open on advisory/telemetry.
Deploy runtime proof required; no build-then-strand.

pr.title: feat(dopecon-bridge): promotable stream relay backstop
pr.body: Publisher-agnostic backstop for promotable events written to dopemux:events. Complements (not replaces) the ConPort direct-emit chronicle fix.

steps.task: Add a fail-open relay consumer for promotable types.
validation: Promotable events on dopemux:events are mirrored to activity.events.v1 with the capture envelope; non-promotable skipped; never blocks; unit-tested. Does NOT replace the ConPort direct-emit (decisions never reach dopemux:events).
